section.title: How Odin's Synthetic Scent Beads Work

how-it-works.content: Place a small amount of beads in mock scrapes, on drag lines, or around stands. The biodegradable polymer matrix releases lab-formulated attractants steadily for 30+ days. The formula resists washing away in rain and maintains effectiveness through temperature changes.
